title: The cgi module was removed in Python 3.13
summary: Python 3.13 removed the cgi module (PEP 594), so importing it raises ModuleNotFoundError.

sources.title: PEP 594 — Removing dead batteries from the standard library

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the cgi import
steps.instructions: Replace each reported import of cgi with the multipart package or email.message.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings treated as errors when pytest is used.
